title: Leader Attachment
description: Defines which character units can attach to which bodyguard units.

eligible_bodyguard_keywords.description: Optional keyword-based eligibility: any unit whose keyword set (keywords ∪ faction_keywords, case-insensitive) contains ALL of these is also an eligible bodyguard, in addition to eligible_bodyguard_ids. Models rules like an Inquisitor leading any IMPERIUM BATTLELINE INFANTRY unit.
